implemented_requirements.requirement: Computer selects a hidden sequence of colors (duplicates allowed)
Player can input guesses of the correct length using letters or full names
implemented_requirements.evidence: Player.get_guess validates length, resolves tokens via _resolve_token, and returns a list of color names.

implemented_requirements.requirement: After each guess, feedback is shown indicating exact matches (right color, right position)
implemented_requirements.evidence: feedback.compute_feedback counts exact matches; Board.render displays `feedback.as_symbols(EXACT_SYMBOL, PARTIAL_SYMBOL, ...)`.

implemented_requirements.requirement: After each guess, feedback is shown indicating partial matches (right color, wrong position)
implemented_requirements.evidence: compute_feedback calculates `partial` and Feedback.as_symbols renders PARTIAL_SYMBOL for them.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Clear win outcome when all positions are exact
implemented_requirements.evidence: GameEngine.play checks `feedback.is_perfect(self.code_length)` and prints a win message.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Clear lose outcome when attempts are exhausted
implemented_requirements.evidence: GameEngine.play checks `self.board.attempts_remaining == 0` and prints a lose message with the secret.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Duplicate colors are handled correctly in scoring
implemented_requirements.evidence: compute_feedback uses Counter to count total color matches, then subtracts exact matches to get partials.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Configurable difficulty (code length, palette size, max attempts)
implemented_requirements.evidence: DIFFICULTIES dict in config.py and Player.choose_difficulty returning kwargs for GameEngine.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board renders history of guesses and feedback
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.render builds a table with each guess and its feedback symbols.

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete Mastermind game: a secret code is generated, the player can enter guesses, feedback distinguishing exact and partial matches is computed and displayed after each attempt, and win/lose outcomes are clearly reported. All core requirements are present, duplicate colors are handled, and difficulty settings are configurable. The code appears ready to run with a high likelihood of successful execution.
